ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTSTATUS_SEC
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus
AS(
	SELECT 
     BSA.ACCTCODE AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BSA.STATUSDATE AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BSA.STATUS AS CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
    ,BSAD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BSA.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSA.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSA.SOURCE_CODE
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS_DELTA BSAD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BSA ON BSA.ACCTCODE = BSAD.ACCTCODE AND BSA.ISLATEST = 1

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId,RECORD_STATUS,FinancialInstitutionId,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId,PeriodStartTimestamp
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId,PeriodStartTimestamp
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus 
WHERE (PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL 
OR PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01' ) 
AND SourceSystemCode = 'SEC'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId,TGT.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId) AS CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp,TGT.PeriodStartTimestamp) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_TGT	TGT
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
and SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
and SRC.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId = TGT.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
and SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp = TGT.PeriodStartTimestamp
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA;


-------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId and  DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId = TGT.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AND DELTA.PeriodStartTimestamp = TGT.PeriodStartTimestamp AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId and SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND SRC.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId = TGT.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AND SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp = TGT.PeriodStartTimestamp 
WHERE (TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL 
OR TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01' )
AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'SEC';


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus  ( 
 CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,CustomerAccountStatusNote
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,SRC.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,NULL AS CustomerAccountStatusNote
,SOURCE_CODE AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId = SRC.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AND DELTA.PeriodStartTimestamp = SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp

-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus  ( 
 CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,CustomerAccountStatusNote
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,NULL AS CustomerAccountStatusNote
,SOURCE_CODE AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');



DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA;

END
